newsitem.title: IRAN: Iran says signs $1 bln steel deal with Italy firm.
newsitem.headline: Iran says signs $1 bln steel deal with Italy firm.

text.p: Iran signed a 3,200 billion rial ($1.07 billion) deal with an Italian firm Saturday to build two new steel plants and boost production in two others, state-run Tehran radio said.

The radio said the Italian company, which it did not name, would help set up two new plants with a total annual capacity of 1.1 milion metric tons in Khorasan province in northeastern Iran and East Azerbaijan province in the northwest.
The funding for the contract, signed for Iran by the state National Iranian Steel Company, included $561 million in long-term credits, it said.

London-based Middle East Economic Digest said in October that Iran had activated a $561 million syndicated loan arranged by European and Japanese banks for a contract by Italy's Danieli & Co. to work on four steel projects in Iran.
